POS_IT.C1.label: C1 · Counter-evidence to be clarified, neutral or unfavourable WWOX readout
POS_IT.C1.plain: The only signed result in WWOX is neutral or unfavourable. The study serves to understand whether that result is real (dose, timing, genotype, depth of reading), not to confirm a hope.
POS_IT.C1.short: counter-evidence to be clarified, neutral or unfavourable WWOX readout
POS_IT.C2.label: C2 · Counter-evidence to be clarified, mixed WWOX readout
POS_IT.C2.plain: For this need, favourable results and neutral or unfavourable results in WWOX stand side by side. The study serves to understand which of the two holds.
POS_IT.C2.short: counter-evidence to be clarified, mixed WWOX readout
POS_IT.C3.label: C3 · Counter-evidence to be clarified, harm or neutral signal from outside WWOX
POS_IT.C3.plain: No signed result in WWOX; what exists outside WWOX (another disease, safety, label) is harmful or neutral, with no favourable signal alongside it. The study serves to understand whether this also applies to WWOX.
POS_IT.C3.short: counter-evidence to be clarified, harm or neutral from outside WWOX
POS_IT.F1.label: F1 · Favourable hypothesis, controlled WWOX readout
POS_IT.F1.plain: A favourable result in a WWOX system, read against an untreated group of the same genotype from a full or partial text, with no neutral, unfavourable or mixed results in WWOX alongside it, and with a next step named. It is a check of reading quality, not the measurement of an effect.
POS_IT.F2.label: F2 · Favourable hypothesis, weak WWOX readout
POS_IT.F2.plain: A favourable result in a WWOX system, but uncontrolled (clinical cases, comparison with wild type only) or of limited depth or specificity, with no neutral or unfavourable results alongside it. The study serves to understand whether the signal is real.
POS_IT.F3.label: F3 · Favourable hypothesis from the target, not proven in WWOX
POS_IT.F3.plain: The need has observations in WWOX systems, but the intervention has not been tested in WWOX; what exists comes from other diseases or from target assays, with no counter-signals. A next step is named.
POS_IT.F3.short: favourable hypothesis from the target, not proven in WWOX
POS_IT.P1.label: P1 · Missing premise, abstention
POS_IT.P1.plain: The card is an abstention: a datum is missing before a test can be designed. The missing datum is the first thing to obtain.
POS_IT.P2.label: P2 · Missing premise, no next step named
POS_IT.P2.plain: The card names no next step for this need, so no study can be proposed from it.
POS_IT.P3.label: P3 · Missing premise, no favourable element recorded
POS_IT.P3.plain: No signed result of the intervention in WWOX and no counter-evidence to be clarified from outside WWOX; in addition, either every favourable support recorded for this need is missing, or every observation of the need in WWOX systems is missing. The card links the need by mechanism only; what is missing is stated in the criteria.
POS_IT.P3.short: missing premise, no favourable element recorded
SCOPE_IT.UNCLASSIFIED: Type of evidence not recorded at the assertion level
SCOPE_IT.WWOX_EXPERIMENT_IN_DEE_SYSTEM: WWOX experiment in a DEE system

UI_IT.ctx_def: The reading is derived from the rule, not assigned by hand. Discordant: resolved signs of opposite direction. Concordant: the same resolved sign in at least two models and none opposed. Single system: sign resolved in one model only. No resolved sign: the measured cells are all within the noise. No data: nothing is measured. A sign is “resolved” only if it is distinguishable from the noise by the criterion of the source, and models are counted, not columns. The cautious reading of the original document may be more conservative: the note on each row says so.
UI_IT.ctx_facts: {cells} cells ({contexts} contexts × {quantities} quantities): {measured} with a measurement or a reported datum and {unknown} unknown. The unknowns are gaps, not zeros. Counting models and not columns, the independent systems number about {models}.

UI_IT.hyp_axis_note: This concerns the ranking methods on the pilot subset, not a judgement on the compound: for this compound the model gives no position.
UI_IT.hyp_ext: External precedents (they are not WWOX evidence)
UI_IT.hyp_h: Hypotheses compared: research priority, model position and observed evidence
UI_IT.hyp_intro_model: Model position: what the comparison of methods says about this hypothesis (the predictive test, further below). Today it says nothing positive for any of the nine: “no position” means not evaluated, not rejected, and “no demonstrated advantage” concerns a method on the pilot subset, never a compound.
UI_IT.hyp_key: Key to the letters: F favourable hypothesis, C counter-evidence to be clarified, P missing premise; the number says where the support comes from (1 controlled in a WWOX system, 2 thin in WWOX, 3 from the target or from another disease). They are positions, not an order.
UI_IT.hyp_lead: Nine hypotheses covering the two research aims and several types of intervention, chosen for coverage and not for merit. Three things remain separate, in distinct blocks: the research priority (position F, C or P and reason from the verification plan: it says where to take the next study, not whether the drug works), the model position and the evidence observed in a WWOX system. No combined score, no order.
UI_IT.hyp_model_none: no model position for this hypothesis
UI_IT.hyp_more: Details: context, favourable, opposing and missing evidence, next experiment
UI_IT.hyp_note_en: The scientific text of the blocks is in English, as in the original comparison. Concentrations and percentages cited from the sources describe external studies: they are not a guide to dosing and are not WWOX evidence.
UI_IT.hyp_obs: Evidence observed in a WWOX system
UI_IT.hyp_r_firewalled: Deliberately excluded from the comparison of methods because it has a curated card (so that the comparison could not be tuned to the compounds already discussed).
UI_IT.hyp_r_not_compound: It is not a compound with a target row: the network method does not apply.
UI_IT.hyp_r_outside_question: Outside the question of the comparison, which concerned a glycolysis/lactate transcript module: proteins, receptors and glia were not its subject.
UI_IT.hyp_usable: The compounds are in the census of the usable ones (they have the input a method requires) but have not been evaluated.
UI_IT.iv_axes: Solidity of the evidence (how much is already measured, and where); priority of the next investigation (how much the next discriminating test is worth); development feasibility (how realistic it is to take the intervention beyond a research probe). One does not imply the others: a row may have weak evidence and high priority.
UI_IT.iv_axes_h: Three different things, kept separate in every row

UI_IT.iv_cond_lead: Conditional proposals shown beside the ordered list, not within it: the ten-row limit keeps them out of the numbering, and no position is implied either by the order in which they appear or by their absence from the list. Each row is a research question with a probe, not a cure and not a qualified hypothesis: what is not known is not ineffective.
UI_IT.iv_curated: The positions are judgements written by research agents and re-read row by row, not a predictive calculation. The code computes no position: it only checks that the fields are complete, that the vocabularies are closed, that the positions are consecutive, that the need and the unit cited exist, that no doses or claims of absolute absence appear and that a conditional hypothesis is never called qualified. Novelty gives no advantage: a new proposal rises only for the reasons written in its row. What is not known is not ineffective.

UI_IT.iv_funnel: The generator produced {g} conditional proposals, {h} handed to qualification; of these {a4} were qualified in depth in IT21 ({k4} kept conditional, {r4} rejected with an informative outcome, {i4} inconclusive). The compound-to-WWOX route produced {p} proposals: {k3} kept conditional, {r3} rejected with an informative outcome, {i3} inconclusive; {q3} were qualified in depth. Qualified hypotheses: {q}. A conditional proposal remains a research question until there is a measurement in a system with altered WWOX.
UI_IT.iv_funnel_h: Where the new proposals come from
UI_IT.iv_it22_lead: Changes in IT22 in the way the generator uses what the repository already contained, with the count that demonstrates them. None of these rows is a scientific result on benefit.
UI_IT.iv_lead: Provisional and reasoned order, with possible ties: each row is a question about a compound or intervention, its action, the context and the benefit sought, with a next test. It is not a ranking of treatments nor a probability of benefit; the depth of the evidence is indicated separately.

UI_IT.iv_neg_lead: Informative negative outcomes: they are not investigations to be funded. They concern the chain as it was written and do not say that a compound is inactive or that the biology is absent: what is not known is not ineffective. Each one states what would reopen it.
UI_IT.iv_nov_note: A novelty holds only within the declared search scope: absence from a card or from a search does not mean “never studied”.

UI_IT.iv_ol_known_in_wwox: starts from a result already observed in a WWOX system (WWOX literature or card)
UI_IT.iv_p5_done: Retrospective measurement (IT21 P5, re-read in IT22): replacing the WWOX starting genes with randomly chosen genes of the same network size, the generator produces almost as many proposals (none of the 5 sets exceeds the 95th percentile of the closest comparisons). The conclusion holds only for the properties measured (number of proposals and membership of random sets): it is not the general conclusion that WWOX adds no value, because network interactions, cell-type-specific contrasts and premises about the role were not measured. It says nothing about prospective benefit, nor that the compounds listed are inactive. It reopens with a datum measured in the WWOX system that distinguishes the proposals.

UI_IT.ov_lead: Which existing drugs, supplements, diets and other interventions are worth studying for the WWOX-related developmental and epileptic encephalopathy (WWOX-DEE)? This page shows what is observed in WWOX, what comes from other diseases or from predictions, what argues against, and which evidence is missing.

The order of the positions is a grouping by type of reason; within a position the order is alphabetical and means nothing. The criteria met and not met are printed with each position.

UI_IT.rk_gp_G1: A favourable result in a WWOX system, read against an untreated group of the same genotype, with no flag blocking the position and no neutral or unfavourable results alongside (position F1: a reading-quality filter on the rows that support the position, which may be a single row; not a measure of the effect and not a recovery after onset).
UI_IT.rk_gp_G2a: A favourable result in a WWOX system with only limits of reading or design (uncontrolled, graph, a single experiment), with no neutral results alongside (position F2).
UI_IT.rk_gp_G2b: As G2a, but with a specificity flag: the effect also appears in wild type, or it is a tool compound, or a drug-by-genotype test is missing, or the wild-type arm is limited by the floor. Not having tested specificity is an unknown, never a clean reading; G2a versus G2b is not an order of efficacy (the source reports lithium better than ethosuximide, a single article, a single laboratory).
UI_IT.rk_gp_G3: Favourable and neutral or unfavourable results in WWOX side by side, or only a neutral result: the study serves to understand which one holds (positions C2, C1). The intervention is listed because it has been tried in a WWOX system, not because its favourable part is stronger than that of untried candidates; the class label describes the pertinence of the favourable part and is not a verdict.
UI_IT.rk_gp_G4a: No test of the intervention in WWOX; favourable support from outside WWOX; the need has observations in WWOX; an action coherent with the direction of the need is documented (position F3). The documented action does not by itself support the relevance to WWOX: the WWOX observation on the need may rest on another intervention.
UI_IT.rk_gp_G4b: As G4a but without a documented coherent action: direction uncertain, action unresolved or no identity in the catalogue (position F3).
UI_IT.rk_gp_G5: No signed result in WWOX, and a signal of harm or a neutral from outside WWOX with nothing favourable alongside, or a link by mechanism only (positions C3, P3).
UI_IT.rk_gp_GU: An abstention: a datum is missing before a test can be designed, or no linked need of this aim has a position. It is not a judgement of poor promise.
UI_IT.rk_h: Provisional ranking of interventions by priority of verification
UI_IT.rk_how_1: The group (G1…GU) says how strong the reason is today to study the intervention further. Within a group there is a tie: the alphabetical order means nothing.
UI_IT.rk_how_2: Three views: general, broad and lasting recovery, partial benefit or bridge. The same intervention can sit in different groups because each view uses only the needs of its own aim; a strong result on symptoms does not cancel interest in a broad-recovery hypothesis, and vice versa.
UI_IT.rk_how_3: Track A/B (dependence on the variant or on the lesion) is a field separate from the group: depth of benefit and genetic applicability are different dimensions.
UI_IT.rk_how_4: An absent datum is “unknown”, not zero. Each count has its own denominator and is not a share of disease treated; linking more needs does not raise the group.

UI_IT.rk_lead: A first, explainable and updatable ordering of the interventions that LEGEND has identified so far. It expresses scientific promise and the priority of the next study. It is not a validated prediction of clinical benefit, not a probability of success, not a therapeutic recommendation and not medical advice.
UI_IT.rk_me_h: Evidence by member (a result for a tool compound or for one member is not a result for the other members)
UI_IT.rk_not_1: It is not a score: the groups are ordinal, have visible components and no hidden weight. No percentage is to be read as a probability of success.
UI_IT.rk_not_2: It is not a ranking of safety or efficacy: access (prescription, over the counter, supplement) is only a description of source, with date and jurisdiction.
UI_IT.rk_not_3: An intervention “still to be evaluated” is not “unpromising”: it is not at the bottom, it is in a separate group with the missing datum named.
UI_IT.rk_not_4: Evidence from other diseases supports a mechanism or an experiment, never a result in WWOX. The same evidence is not counted more than once (preprint, article, database, articles that cite it).
UI_IT.rk_not_member: is not among the interventions of this aim
UI_IT.rk_nxp_NX1: The next discriminating experiment would change a decision (raise or stop).
UI_IT.rk_nxp_NX2: The next experiment resolves a limit; the decision shifts by one step at most.
UI_IT.rk_nxp_NX3: No discriminating step indicated, or the outcome could not change the decision before a premise exists.
UI_IT.rk_one_note: The general selection and the two selections by aim on one A4 page. The full fields are in the cards above.
UI_IT.rk_p3: IT7 exploratory information: the network and signature comparison (256 families) was neither detected nor excluded, deliberately excluded the curated cards and cannot by itself drive any position. No entry is ordered or reordered by it.
UI_IT.rk_p_comp: Computational prediction: none for this intervention. The IT7 pilot comparison was exploratory, deliberately excluded the curated cards and cannot by itself drive the ranking.
UI_IT.rk_p_conflict: two cards of the same intervention have different positions on this need; the position that does not hide the counter-evidence remains
UI_IT.rk_p_den: {n} linked needs out of {m}: a count of links, not a share of disease treated; it does not raise the group.
UI_IT.rk_q_Q1: Q1 · target listed with action coherent with the direction, on a need with an evaluable direction (depth E1c)
UI_IT.rk_q_Q2: Q2 · target listed on a need of uncertain direction or unresolved action: exploration list only (E1)
UI_IT.rk_q_Q3: Q3 · linked only through a pathway member, counted separately (E1p)
UI_IT.rk_q_Q4: Q4 · documented action but no linked need of the module (E0a)
UI_IT.rk_q_UNIT: members of an entry already ordered (E3)
UI_IT.rk_sel_note: A selection lists at most ten interventions from groups G1, G2a, G2b, G3 and G4a, only when the evaluation supports them; never padded to reach ten. Ties stay whole. G4b and the following groups are listed separately.
UI_IT.rk_t_note: All the interventions, including those that cannot be ordered: none is omitted. The group of each view is a result of the rule, not a hand-made choice.
UI_IT.rk_three_1: Biological promise: this is the group (G1…GU), computed from the positions; it contains neither the depth nor the priority of the next experiment.
UI_IT.rk_three_2: Depth of evidence: how much has been read and at what level (E0…E4); it does not enter the group.
UI_IT.rk_three_3: Priority of the next experiment (NX1…NX3): informative value = how much the next discriminating experiment would change a decision. It does not depend on how many times a candidate has been studied (a heavily studied candidate is not for that reason more promising, a little-studied one is not for that reason a discovery) nor on cost: cost and feasibility are a separate flag.
UI_IT.rk_three_h: Three separate fields, readable on their own
UI_IT.rk_top_none: No intervention of this view is in a selectable group.
UI_IT.rk_trg_h: Which new developments prompt a re-evaluation
UI_IT.rk_trg_note: The new developments that prompt a re-evaluation of an intervention are detected by a fingerprint of its inputs; the fingerprint raises a flag, a reader decides. The existing daily radar flags the sources that changed.
UI_IT.rk_unc_c_r: Reason and what would reopen it
UI_IT.rk_unc_h: Other interventions identified, without a card
UI_IT.rk_unc_note: Searched for, excluded or with a potentially opposite effect, but without a card: they are not ordered and are not at the bottom. Each has a class, a depth and what would reopen it. A search that abstains has not shown that the item is unpromising.
UI_IT.rk_v_general: General (the best group between the two aims)
UI_IT.rk_x_n: entries of counter-evidence at need level (of the need, not of the intervention)
UI_IT.rk_x_o: neutral or harmful claims from outside WWOX
UI_IT.rk_x_opp: needs with a documented opposite action
UI_IT.rk_x_w: neutral, harmful or mixed claims in WWOX systems
UI_IT.sel_c_note: What it means and what is missing
UI_IT.sel_h: Selection of compounds: from the catalogue to the next test
UI_IT.sel_i_card_linked: Families linked to a curated card
UI_IT.sel_i_cards_next: Cards with a named next step (abstentions excluded)
UI_IT.sel_i_eval_methods: Evaluated by the two methods across the whole catalogue
UI_IT.sel_i_eval_wwox_readout: With a pertinent readout in a WWOX system
UI_IT.sel_i_l1: With at least one target row
UI_IT.sel_i_l2: With documented action, passing the anti-artefact rules
UI_IT.sel_i_mnet: Usable by the network method (M-net): signed action on a human target with a stable identifier
UI_IT.sel_i_mnet_corr: of which with a row corroborated by ChEMBL or GtoPdb
UI_IT.sel_i_mnet_dgidb_only: of which entries from DGIdb alone, mode unknown
UI_IT.sel_i_msig_any: With a compound signature in any cell context (M-sig)
UI_IT.sel_i_msig_neural: With a signature in cells of neural lineage (M-sig, strict definition)
UI_IT.sel_i_msig_testable: Testable by the signature method (M-sig): they have a structural key
UI_IT.sel_i_msig_unknown: Unknown for M-sig: no structural key
UI_IT.sel_i_need_action: of which with a declared action on a target of the need
UI_IT.sel_i_need_link: With a documented link to a need (intervention target)
UI_IT.sel_i_needs_plan: Needs with an entry in the verification plan
UI_IT.sel_i_rows_excluded: Target rows excluded by the anti-artefact rules
UI_IT.sel_i_source_only: of which source-only families, identity unresolved
UI_IT.sel_k_h: What each number counts: biological links and experimental results
UI_IT.sel_k_l1: Biological link: intervention target documented for the need (association)
UI_IT.sel_k_l2: Mechanistic coherence: direction coherent with the need / opposite / direction unresolved
UI_IT.sel_k_l3: Effect observed, of which in a WWOX system
UI_IT.sel_k_l4: Recovery observed in a WWOX system, of which experimental
UI_IT.sel_k_note: Unit: cells (family or intervention × need) of the matrix; the levels are never summed and none is a share of disease treated.
UI_IT.sel_lead: A funnel built from measured units, in this order: catalogued, usable with a calculation, actually evaluated, pertinent by mechanism, ready for a named test. Each indicator states its unit and its denominator; unknown or excluded compounds are counted with the reason. It is not a ranking and not a screen of the catalogue.
UI_IT.sel_n_card_linked: The subset that has a written hypothesis and a next step.
UI_IT.sel_n_cards: Interventions or classes, not compounds: they include diet, vectors and supplements.
UI_IT.sel_n_cards_next: “Ready for a named test” does not mean “recommended”: no compound is recommended and no individual-level data are used.
UI_IT.sel_n_catalogued: The families are an upper bound: the same drug may appear as a ChEMBL family and as a source-only family.
UI_IT.sel_n_eval_methods: Zero: “usable” is a requirement on the input, not a result; no compound was scored or ordered by the methods on the catalogue.
UI_IT.sel_n_eval_p3: Families chosen for data availability among those of the pilot subset: this is NOT a screen of the catalogue. The result measures the opposition of a module in wild-type neural cells, not an effect in cells lacking WWOX.
UI_IT.sel_n_eval_wwox_readout: Interventions with a pertinent WWOX observation: this is different from the score of the methods.
UI_IT.sel_n_l1: A row of curated mechanism or interaction: it is a presence in a database.
UI_IT.sel_n_l2: The action is what the source declares, not necessarily a pharmacological modulation: immunisation antigens, exogenous proteins and sequestering agents are also admitted.
UI_IT.sel_n_mnet: A sign declared by the source, not measured: it is not potency and not relevance to WWOX.
UI_IT.sel_n_mnet_corr: The three sources are not independent votes: they overlap.
UI_IT.sel_n_mnet_dgidb_only: An antibody or a peptide is not distinguished from a small molecule; the DGIdb lists are taken as declared.
UI_IT.sel_n_msig_any: The share on the testable alone is the correct reading; the share on the total underestimates it because most cannot be tested.
UI_IT.sel_n_msig_neural: Neural cells of unknown genotype, no perturbation of WWOX, no glia, signatures mostly at a single concentration.
UI_IT.sel_n_msig_testable: It is the correct denominator for the M-sig shares.
UI_IT.sel_n_msig_unknown: It is not a negative result: without structure the signature cannot be searched. Reasons, in records:
UI_IT.sel_n_need_action: The action is declared by the source; the direction towards the need is resolved only where a role row allows it.
UI_IT.sel_n_need_link: Target association: it is neither a directional prediction nor an observed effect.
UI_IT.sel_n_needs_plan: The plan follows the order of the needs register, without a ranking.
UI_IT.sel_n_rows_excluded: Reasons: identity not confirmed, source artefacts, alias risk.
UI_IT.sel_n_source_only: They are never merged by name.
UI_IT.sel_ov_h: Overlap of the two methods (strict neural signature versus network), on the testable alone
UI_IT.sel_ov_note: In the “neither one nor the other” of the total also fall the compounds without a structural key, whose M-sig state is unknown and not negative: for this reason here the denominator is the testable alone.
UI_IT.sel_pv_eval0: by the two methods on the catalogue
UI_IT.sel_pv_eval1: families in the pilot comparison (exploratory subset, not a screen)
UI_IT.sel_pv_eval2: records with a pertinent readout in a WWOX system
UI_IT.sel_pv_h: Present in the catalogue does not mean evaluated
UI_IT.sel_pv_present: source entries and families listed: a presence in a list, not a judgement on the compound.
UI_IT.sel_units: Units. A record is a source entry (a salt or a stereoisomer each count once, and are not distinct drugs). A family is the “compound” of this census and the number of families is an upper bound of the distinct compounds, because source-only entries are never merged by name. A card is an intervention or a class studied, not a compound.
UI_IT.sel_warn_prob: No calibrated clinical probability is shown, because none has been validated; the model percentile is not shown at all.
UI_IT.sel_warn_share: A share of biological pathways or of linked targets is not a share of disease treated: a target link is a documented association, not a directional prediction nor an observed effect.
UI_IT.source_limited: Some sources have a limited status
UI_IT.source_limited_tail: A missing datum is not a conclusion about the biology.
UI_IT.src_full: Complete local version: includes third-party rows, not for redistribution.
UI_IT.src_share: Shareable version: third-party rows are limited to the permitted list.
UI_IT.sub: Research material, not medical advice nor a ranking of treatments. Level of the disease and of the reference genotype, no individual-level data.
UI_IT.tag_outside: counter-evidence from outside WWOX in {n} rows
UI_IT.tag_qual: next to an arm “not normalised to wild type”
UI_IT.tag_tool: tool compound, not a candidate drug
UI_IT.tag_wt: {n} comparison(s) with wild type only, counted in no direction
UI_IT.tc_actions: Catalogue actions on the targets of the needs (source statements, not modulation in a WWOX system)
UI_IT.tc_against: All the counter-evidence of the card
UI_IT.tc_asserts: Claims about the intervention in the card
UI_IT.tc_cardfile: Card file (path in the repository, local use only)
UI_IT.tc_for: Evidence in favour, as written in the card
UI_IT.tc_identity: Identity and mechanism (as written in the card)
UI_IT.tc_links_h: All linked needs and why the letter is this one
UI_IT.tc_lvl_note: The level is that of the source record; an action on a broad group is not a measurement on the single gene. An abstention explains why the direction is not attributed.
UI_IT.tc_nosrc: No public identifier is linked to this card.
UI_IT.tc_obs: Observations in the registers of the linked needs
UI_IT.tc_text_en: Technical text taken from the card, in English; it may cite internal references (CLAIM n, A-xxx-n, T1, DL-…) that are not needed for reading and cannot be consulted outside the repository.
UI_IT.td_cit_note: Titles, citations and identifiers of the sources are reported in the original form.
UI_IT.td_en_only: This section (full matrix, filters, need cards, registries and technical data) is available only in the original language of the data, English: filters, links and identifiers work as in the other languages.
UI_IT.td_full_h: Full data level (the screening behind the curated view)
UI_IT.td_full_note: The following sections are the complete screening of the catalogue: funnel, access categories, needs, complete matrix of pairs, every priority disposition, leads, limits and technical details. They are exhaustive, unordered and are not lists of candidates. Technical text in English.
UI_IT.td_note: Versions, fingerprints, regeneration command, source states and the complete screening of the catalogue. They are separate from the exploration above, in technical English, exhaustive and unordered: they are not lists of candidates.
UI_IT.th_evid: Type of evidence observed in the needs
UI_IT.th_gap_card: Missing datum declared in the card
UI_IT.th_gap_l4: needs for which no intervention has an observed recovery in WWOX
UI_IT.th_gap_wwox: needs without any observation in a WWOX system
UI_IT.th_note: Each box summarises a group of needs that share the biology: the aim, the candidates, the reason for the priority, the type of evidence and the decisive gap.
UI_IT.th_obs_note: (volume of observations, not strength of evidence)
UI_IT.th_why: Reason for the priority (one candidate–need link each)
UI_IT.track_A: Track A: variant-independent (acts whatever the WWOX allele)
UI_IT.track_B: Track B: variant- or lesion-specific (an allele class, a splice site, a stop codon)
UI_IT.track_none_s: Track: not indicated in the card
UI_IT.ui_lang_note: Orientation texts in English; titles, citations, identifiers, source passages and compound names remain in the original form.
UI_IT.unit_note: A need is a biological question, a card is a written candidate, a record is a source entry, a family is a grouping of records: they are not summed nor compared as a single number.
UI_IT.warn_1: Research material for discussion with the treating clinical team: it is not medical advice nor an indication of treatment.
UI_IT.warn_2: A priority letter says why an intervention is worth studying, not how well it works: it is not a score nor a probability.
UI_IT.warn_3: That a piece of information is missing (access, outcome, counter-evidence) does not mean that it is negative: it means that it has not been obtained.
UI_IT.wo_dates_note: two different dates: the first is the last update of this work order, the second the construction of the catalogue of the compounds
UI_IT.wo_fig_tab: Table of the values of the figure
UI_IT.wo_note: A list by need, in the order of the needs register: it is not a work sequence, not a ranking of needs or of treatments and has no score. For each need: the reason for the next study (verify a hypothesis, clarify a counter-evidence or resolve a premise, coherent with the F, C, P positions of the need), a line in English, the question, the data that could resolve it, what would change and the feasibility actually known (“unknown” when it is not).
UI_IT.wo_text_en: Scientific text in English, as stored.
UI_IT.ws_recovered_post_onset_model: recovery after onset (in a model only)
UI_IT.xp_access_note: Access category as declared by the source, with the country when known; a historical approval does not prove current availability and the absence of data does not mean “not accessible”. Dietary interventions remain complex interventions.
UI_IT.xp_actions_none: no action on a target of the need recorded in the catalogue for this card
UI_IT.xp_actions_withheld: The actions of the compound on the targets come from databases whose content is not redistributable in this version (ChEMBL CC BY-SA 3.0, DGIdb): they are in the complete local version. Here the card–need link is the one declared by the card.
UI_IT.xp_future: Fields that the engine is adding (original source and republishing source, effective level of the target, specific evidence) appear here on their own when present in the data.
UI_IT.xp_graph_note: Solid line: measurement in WWOX; dashed: inference from outside WWOX; dotted: hypothesis. Thin grey: target declared by the needs register. The table below the graph says the same things in words.
UI_IT.xp_h: Explore: from a need to the interventions, or from a compound to its needs
UI_IT.xp_lead: Choose a need to see targets, linked interventions and what supports or weakens them; or choose a compound or intervention to see actions, linked needs, counter-evidence and gaps.
UI_IT.xp_need_counter: What argues against, on the need
UI_IT.xp_needs_of_card: Linked needs and reason for the priority
UI_IT.xp_noscript: This exploration requires JavaScript; the same information is in the cards and in the navigation by need further down.
UI_IT.xp_res_rows: pertinent rows: {w} in WWOX, {o} outside WWOX; {n} neutral, {h} of harm
UI_IT.xp_targets_none: no molecular target listed (the need is defined on a function or a phenotype)
